citations.label: Artificial Analysis, Intelligence Index v5 methodology (Intelligence Index weighting)
citations.excerpt: AA-Omniscience contributes two components to the Intelligence Index: (1)  Accuracy  - the proportion of correct answers, weighted at 10% of the overall Index, and (2)  Non-Hallucination Rate  - calculated as 1 minus the hallucination rate, weighted at 5% of the overall Index

citations.label: Artificial Analysis, Intelligence Index v5 methodology (Index scoring rule)
citations.excerpt: Models are scored using the  AA-Omniscience Index , which assigns points for correct answers, subtracts points for hallucinated responses, and keeps abstentions neutral, rewarding abstentions over incorrect guesses
